meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 当用户要求盯一个 Pull Request 时，Claude 会反复查看其 CI 检查、评论和 review 线程，修复真正的问题并推送，直到检查通过、无可操作评论和未解决线程才停止。
howto.when: 当你说“babysit”“monitor”“持续检查”等，或要求一直盯着某个 PR 直到可以合并时触发。

say.text: 帮我盯着这个PR，CI过了就告诉我。
say.note: 它会持续轮询直到检查完成。

say.text: 持续监控PR #42，有新评论就处理。
say.note: 它会阅读新评论并修复问题。

say.text: 照看这个review，直到所有线程解决。
say.note: 只有当所有未解决线程清零才报告。

howto.what_en: When asked to babysit a pull request, Claude repeatedly checks CI, comments, and review threads, fixes real issues in commits, and pushes until checks pass and no actionable comments or unresolved threads remain.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'babysit', 'monitor', 'keep checking', or asks to watch a PR until it is ready to merge.

say_en.text: Keep an eye on this PR and tell me when CI passes.
say_en.note: It will poll until checks finish.

say_en.text: Monitor PR #42 and handle new comments.
say_en.note: It reads new comments and fixes issues.

say_en.text: Watch this review until all threads are resolved.
say_en.note: Reports only when no unresolved threads remain.
